reels.title: Day 2 [study mood]
storyboard: Late-night study/work scene with the person focused on the laptop and Mazaq beside them.
The person continues studying while the voice-over says: “وراكم مذاكرة كتير؟”
A subtle camera movement reveals the Mazaq coffee, connecting it naturally to the study moment.
reels.whyItWorks: The reel uses a relatable study moment and a simple voice-over to position Mazaq as a small boost that makes long study days feel better. The product is integrated naturally into the scene rather than feeling like a hard sell.

reels.title: Perfect Karak in 30 Seconds
storyboard: Close-up of the Mazaq Karak sachet and an empty cup.
Pour the Mazaq Karak mix into the cup.
Pour hot water into the cup and watch the drink dissolve.
Stir the Karak until it becomes smooth and creamy.
Final close-up of the freshly prepared Mazaq Karak with gentle steam rising.
reels.whyItWorks: A quick and satisfying preparation video that shows how easy it is to make Mazaq Karak in just 30 seconds, while highlighting the product and creating a warm, appetizing everyday moment.
